entries.text: 虽然我们是突然来打扰，\n却还是享用了一顿美餐呢！[VAR 0x0114(0004)]
entries.label: s2_side01_0020_rival_00

entries.text: [VAR 0x0100(0000)]的妈妈\n做的饭可真好吃啊！！[VAR 0x0114(0006)]
entries.label: s2_side01_0020_friend_01

entries.text: 对吧！对吧！我也觉得！\n而且还那么漂亮，吓了我一跳。[VAR 0x0114(0008)]
entries.label: s2_side01_0020_botan_01

entries.text: 阿姨还记得我，\n真高兴～！[VAR 0x0114(0004)]
entries.label: s2_side01_0020_rival_01

entries.text: 你的房间也好厉害啊！\n比宿舍宽敞太多了！[VAR 0x0114(0006)]
entries.label: s2_side01_0020_friend_02

entries.text: 虽然总感觉\n有点过于可爱了……[VAR 0x0114(0006)]
entries.label: s2_side01_0020_friend_03

entries.text: 哇～是Nintendo Switch！\n好在意你有什么游戏～[VAR 0x0114(0008)]
entries.label: s2_side01_0020_botan_02

entries.text: 贪心栗鼠的布偶！\n真好啊！毛茸茸的！[VAR 0x0114(0004)]
entries.label: s2_side01_0020_rival_02

entries.text: 大家都吃饱了吗？我想问问\n你们要不要再吃些点心。[VAR 0x0114(002B)]
entries.label: s2_side01_0020_mama_01

entries.text: 不不不！这怎么好意思！\n你……您太热情了！！[VAR 0x0114(0006)]
entries.label: s2_side01_0020_friend_04

entries.text: 呵呵，\n不用那么拘谨啦。[VAR 0x0114(002B)]
entries.label: s2_side01_0020_mama_02

entries.text: 你们就把这里当成\n自己的家，放松一点就好。[VAR 0x0114(002B)]
entries.label: s2_side01_0020_mama_03

entries.text: 对了，[VAR 0x0100(0000)]，\n家里收到一个信封。[VAR 0x0114(002B)]
entries.label: s2_side01_0020_mama_04

entries.text: 寄信人叫乌栗。\n……你认识吗？[VAR 0x0114(002B)]
entries.label: s2_side01_0020_mama_05

entries.text: 你的朋友好多呀！[VAR 0x0114(002B)]
entries.label: s2_side01_0020_mama_06

entries.text: 哎呀，是这样吗……？\n总之我先把信交给你了哦。[VAR 0x0114(002B)]
entries.label: s2_side01_0020_mama_07

entries.text: 我去把点心拿过来，\n你们好好期待吧。[VAR 0x0114(002B)]
entries.label: s2_side01_0020_mama_09

entries.text: 话说回来，你不用看看\n信封里面是什么吗？[VAR 0x0114(0006)]
entries.label: s2_side01_0020_friend_07

entries.text:
致[VAR 0x0100(0000)]

你过得还好吗？
我正在休假，
从学园回到翠绿镇了。
我姐也和我一起回老家了。
entries.label: s2_side01_0020_system_01

entries.text:
自从大空洞以来就没怎么和你见面，
所以我想再次见到[VAR 0x0100(0000)]你。
可以的话，要不要和你在帕底亚的
朋友们一起来北上乡一趟呢？
我在里面放了几张票。
我姐也很期待能见到你。
entries.label: s2_side01_0020_system_02

entries.text: 这家伙是谁啊？\n……是你的朋友吗？[VAR 0x0114(0006)]
entries.label: s2_side01_0020_friend_08

entries.text: 是朋友！
entries.label: s2_side01_0020_select_01

entries.text: 差不多吧
entries.label: s2_side01_0020_select_02

entries.text: “差不多”算什么啊？\n哎……算了。[VAR 0x0114(0006)]
entries.label: s2_side01_0020_friend_10

entries.text: [VAR 0x0100(0000)]～！派帕～！\n点心比我想得还要厉害哇～！[VAR 0x0114(0004)]
entries.label: s2_side01_0020_rival_04

entries.text: 不好拿上去，\n你们来下面吃吧～！[VAR 0x0114(0004)]
entries.label: s2_side01_0020_rival_05

entries.text: 妮莫的声音\n也太大了吧。[VAR 0x0114(0006)]
entries.label: s2_side01_0020_friend_11

entries.text: 真拿她没办法，我们过去吧！[VAR 0x0114(0006)]
entries.label: s2_side01_0020_friend_12

entries.text: 啊～肚子好撑～\n已经吃不下了～[VAR 0x0114(0008)]
entries.label: s2_side01_0020_botan_05

entries.text: 你应该说“多谢款待”才对吧！[VAR 0x0114(0006)]
entries.label: s2_side01_0020_friend_13

entries.text: 我来帮忙洗碗！[VAR 0x0114(0004)]
entries.label: s2_side01_0020_rival_06

entries.text: 谢谢你，妮莫。\n不过没关系啦，你休息就好。[VAR 0x0114(002B)]
entries.label: s2_side01_0020_mama_10

entries.text: 不愧是妮莫，\n真是懂事。[VAR 0x0114(0006)]
entries.label: s2_side01_0020_friend_14

entries.text: ……是叫北上乡来着吧？[VAR 0x0114(0006)]
entries.label: s2_side01_0020_friend_17

entries.text: 你又要去见\n那个叫乌栗的人了吗？[VAR 0x0114(0006)]
entries.label: s2_side01_0020_friend_18

entries.text: 我们一起去吧！
entries.label: s2_side01_0020_select_03

entries.text: 大家一起去吧！
entries.label: s2_side01_0020_select_04

entries.text: 什么什么～！？\n你们在聊什么～！？[VAR 0x0114(0004)]
entries.label: s2_side01_0020_rival_08

entries.text: 诶～！遇到这种情况，\n那不是肯定要一起去嘛！[VAR 0x0114(0004)]
entries.label: s2_side01_0020_rival_09

entries.text: 我也好想见一见\n对战强校的冠军乌栗啊～！[VAR 0x0114(0004)]
entries.label: s2_side01_0020_rival_10

entries.text: 是“想和他对战”才对吧？[VAR 0x0114(0008)]
entries.label: s2_side01_0020_botan_08

entries.text: 让你给看出来啦～？[VAR 0x0114(0004)]
entries.label: s2_side01_0020_rival_11

entries.text: 感觉真不好意思啊……\n就好像在强迫你邀请我们一样。[VAR 0x0114(0006)]
entries.label: s2_side01_0020_friend_20

entries.text: 信上不是说了让朋友一起来，\n还给了票嘛！[VAR 0x0114(0004)]
entries.label: s2_side01_0020_rival_12

entries.text: 朋友不就是指我们嘛？[VAR 0x0114(0008)]
entries.label: s2_side01_0020_botan_09

entries.text: 和朋友一起旅行……\n我这还是第一次。[VAR 0x0114(0008)]
entries.label: s2_side01_0020_botan_10

entries.text: 总感觉……开始激动起来了。[VAR 0x0114(0008)]
entries.label: s2_side01_0020_botan_12

entries.text: 这么一说……\n我可能也是第一次。[VAR 0x0114(0006)]
entries.label: s2_side01_0020_friend_21

entries.text: 原来如此！\n真是超级期待呢！[VAR 0x0114(0004)]
entries.label: s2_side01_0020_rival_14

entries.text: 我也和家里的保姆说一下\n要去旅行的事吧。[VAR 0x0114(0004)]
entries.label: s2_side01_0020_rival_15

entries.text: 大家应该也需要做准备，\n我们暂时先解散，之后再集合吧！[VAR 0x0114(0004)]
entries.label: s2_side01_0020_rival_16

entries.text: 好！那就……\n在[VAR 0xFF00(0006)]桌台市南门前[VAR 0xFF00(0000)]见！[VAR 0x0114(0006)]
entries.label: s2_side01_0020_friend_22

entries.text: OK～！\n那就待会儿见！[VAR 0x0114(0008)]
entries.label: s2_side01_0020_botan_13

entries.text: 我们回去了，阿姨再见～！[VAR 0x0114(004C)]
entries.label: s2_side01_0020_all_01

entries.text: 哎呀，妮莫她们\n已经回去了啊。[VAR 0x0114(002B)]
entries.label: s2_side01_0020_mama_11

entries.text: 你的朋友们都是好孩子，\n连妈妈我都高兴起来了。[VAR 0x0114(002B)]
entries.label: s2_side01_0020_mama_12

entries.text: 这次你们要\n一起出门冒险了吧。[VAR 0x0114(002B)]
entries.label: s2_side01_0020_mama_13

entries.text: 好好相处，不要吵架。\n祝你们一路顺风哦！[VAR 0x0114(002B)]
entries.label: s2_side01_0020_mama_14
